newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads five for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads five for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Tuesday beheaded five foreigners -- two women and three men -- for drug smuggling, Saudi state television reported.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television said four Pakistanis -- two women and two men -- and a Nigerian man were executed.
The beheadings raised to 58 the number of people executed in the conservative Moslem kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
